subject.title: ci: defer macOS tests for draft pull requests

question: Should the aggregate required CI check intentionally pass for code-changing draft pull requests while macOS validation is deferred until ready-for-review?
rationale: The implementation is coherent and tested, but source review cannot authorize the repository-level choice to show a green required check before platform validation has run.

options.title: Approve green deferral
options.body: Allow drafts to pass the aggregate gate with an explicit deferred summary and require fresh macOS shards when promoted.

options.title: Keep required gate non-green
options.body: Revise deferred draft runs so the aggregate required check remains pending or non-passing until macOS validation completes.

recommendation.title: Approve green deferral
recommendation.body: Allow drafts to pass the aggregate gate with an explicit deferred summary and require fresh macOS shards when promoted.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner and a recent contributor to the CI workflow, steipete is the clearest decision owner for branch-protection semantics.
